title: PostAbortReviewOutputContract
description: Result of the abort-review step (ADR-0032 decider zone). Written to {jobFolder}/contracts/post-abort-review-output.json. Mirrors backend/Services/Runner/PostAbortReviewStepService.cs::PostAbortReviewOutputContract. The model supplies the verdict (recommendation/legitimateAbort/confidence/reasoning); the binding 'action' is computed by the pure PostAbortReviewDecider from the recommendation plus the remaining rerun budget. A null/unparseable verdict (parsed=false) fails closed to action=human-review.

project.description: Project name as it appears in WatchPaths and runner status.

jobId.description: Slug-form job id of the task whose run aborted.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the review step started.

parsed.description: True when a verdict was recovered from the model reply. False means the reply was empty/unparseable and the step failed closed.

legitimateAbort.description: Model judgement (legitimer_abbruch): whether the abort was a genuine dead end. Null when parsed=false.

recommendation.description: Model's recommended next action (empfehlung). Null when parsed=false.

confidence.description: Model self-rated confidence in [0,1]. Null when parsed=false.

reasoning.description: One short justification (begruendung) from the model. Null when parsed=false.

action.description: Binding next action chosen by the code-side decider. Escalates to human-review when the model recommended it OR the rerun budget is exhausted OR parsed=false.

rerunBudgetRemaining.description: Automatic reruns this job had left when the decision was made.

rawReply.description: Trimmed raw model reply captured for audit. Null when the model returned nothing.
